title: Disney Easy Wins
description: Classic animated trivia almost everyone gets right. Warm-up pack.

questions.prompt: What kind of animal is Simba in The Lion King?
Who is Ariel's father in The Little Mermaid?
questions.explanation: Triton rules the underwater kingdom of Atlantica in The Little Mermaid (1989) and wields a magical golden trident.

questions.prompt: Who voiced the Genie in Disney's 1992 Aladdin?
questions.explanation: Williams ad-libbed so much of the role that the film was disqualified from a Best Adapted Screenplay Oscar nomination.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the snowman in Frozen?
questions.explanation: Built by Anna and Elsa as kids, Olaf is brought to life by Elsa's magic and famously dreams of summer.

questions.prompt: What year was Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs released?
questions.explanation: It was Disney's first feature-length animated film and the first full-length cel-animated feature ever made in America.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Mowgli's bear friend in The Jungle Book?
questions.explanation: Baloo sings 'The Bare Necessities' and teaches Mowgli his easygoing philosophy in the 1967 Disney classic.

questions.prompt: What city is The Princess and the Frog set in?
questions.explanation: Released in 2009 and set in Jazz Age Louisiana, it features Tiana as Disney's first Black princess.

questions.prompt: Who is Mulan's tiny dragon sidekick?
questions.explanation: Voiced by Eddie Murphy in Mulan (1998), Mushu is a disgraced family guardian trying to redeem himself.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Peter Pan's fairy companion?
questions.explanation: Originally from J.M. Barrie's play, she appeared in Disney's 1953 Peter Pan and later became a Disney mascot.

questions.prompt: Who is the villain in The Lion King?
questions.explanation: Mufasa's jealous younger brother, Scar plots with the hyenas and was voiced by Jeremy Irons in the 1994 film.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Pocahontas' raccoon companion?
questions.explanation: The mischievous food-obsessed raccoon constantly torments Governor Ratcliffe's pampered pug Percy throughout Pocahontas (1995).

questions.prompt: Who is Elsa's younger sister in Frozen?
questions.explanation: Anna's act of true love saving Elsa is what breaks the curse at the climax of Frozen (2013).

questions.prompt: What is the name of the rabbit in Bambi?
questions.explanation: Named for how he thumps his back foot, Thumper delivers the famous line 'If you can't say something nice, don't say nothin' at all.'

questions.prompt: Who is Hercules' winged horse?
questions.explanation: In Disney's Hercules (1997), Pegasus is a baby gift from Zeus, magically formed out of a cloud.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Belle's father in Beauty and the Beast?
questions.explanation: Maurice is an eccentric inventor whose getting lost in the woods leads Belle to the Beast's castle in the 1991 film.

questions.prompt: Which Disney princess has a pet tiger named Rajah?
questions.explanation: Rajah is Princess Jasmine's fiercely loyal Bengal tiger and constant palace companion in Aladdin (1992).

questions.prompt: What is the name of the chameleon in Tangled?
questions.explanation: Rapunzel's silent green sidekick in Tangled (2010), Pascal communicates entirely through expressions and color changes.

questions.prompt: What is Moana's pet pig's name?
questions.explanation: The adorable pig stays behind on Motunui in Moana (2016) while the dim-witted chicken Heihei accidentally joins the voyage.

questions.prompt: Which Disney film features the song 'A Whole New World'?
questions.explanation: The magic carpet duet from Aladdin (1992) won the Oscar for Best Original Song that year.

questions.prompt: Who is the candelabra in Beauty and the Beast?
questions.explanation: The charming maître d' of the enchanted castle leads the showstopping 'Be Our Guest' number in the 1991 film.
